newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PEKAO SA BANK TO UP CREDIT RATE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PEKAO SA BANK TO UP CREDIT RATE.

text.p: Poland's state-owned Pekao SA bank will raise its base rate for credits by one percentage point as of Monday, August 11, its spokeswoman said on Thursday.
"Pekao SA's board decided on Wednesday to raise its base rate for credits from 25 to 26 percent as of August 11," Beata Wojcik told Reuters.
Wojcik said the bank did not increase its deposit rates.
On Monday the central bank increased its lombard rate by two points to 27 percent and its discount rate by 2.5 points to 24.5 percent.
